description: Fixtures with reference cycles for the §7a cycle-profile cases. Calc.SelfRef (=SelfRef+1) is a divergent self-cycle; Calc.Converge (=Converge/2+5) is a convergent self-cycle (→10); Calc.A/Calc.B (=B+10, =A/2) are a convergent two-node SCC (→20,10); Calc.Downstream (=A+1) depends on the region; Calc.TextCycle (=TextCycle & "x") is a non-numeric self-cycle.
